messages:
alex: Heads up — Grafana SLO noise for 'api-serving 99th' started ~10:05. Alerts show remote_write queue growing on prometheus-main. ops-bot: alert: prometheus_remote_storage_queued_samples_total > 1000
maria: seeing write backpressure in metrics: `prometheus_remote_storage_queued_samples_total{instance=\"prom-main-1\"} 2380`
jordan: also noticing scrape failures from gpu-node-exporter pods, lots of 504s from remote_write endpoint
alex: logs from prom-main: `level=warn ts=2026-03-18T10:08:12Z component=remote` \"failed to send samples: send request failed: context deadline exceeded\"
len: maybe send_timeout is too low for our large batching. Current is 30s? run `kubectl get secret prometheus-config -o yaml` to check
maria: config snippet I pulled:
```
remote_write:
  - url: https://rw-redwood.example.com/api/v1/write
    queue_config:
      max_shards: 200
      max_samples_per_send: 5000
      send_batch_size: 1000
      send_deadline: 30s
    send_timeout: 10s
    write_relabel_configs: []
```
maria: ah send_timeout is 10s, send_deadline 30s — that mismatch could create canceled requests (client gives up early)
jordan: we also have cardinality spikes from `gpu_uuid` and `cuda_ctx` labels in nvmetrics. That inflates queue and remote_write can't keep up
alex: suggestion: add write_relabel_configs to drop high-cardinality labels for metrics matching `nvidia_gpu_*` and bump queue shards
len: try this relabel snippet for canary:
```
- source_labels: [__name__]
  regex: 'nvidia_gpu_.*'
  action: keep
- source_labels: [gpu_uuid]
  regex: '.+'
  action: labeldrop
- source_labels: [cuda_ctx]
  regex: '.+'
  action: labeldrop
```
maria: note: `labeldrop` is global so scope carefully — maybe use `metric_relabel_configs` instead for specific metrics, or use `action: replace` with `replacement: \"<masked>\"` if you need a token
jordan: I'm going to test on prom-canary, will apply relabel and increase `max_shards` 200 -> 400 and set `send_timeout` 10s -> 60s
alex: canary applied at 10:24, prometheus metrics improved: queued_samples_total down from 2.3k -> 120 in ~3m
ops-bot: deploy: prometheus-canary config updated by jordan — https://deploys.redwood.example.com/ci/7890 :white_check_mark:
maria: SLO alerts suppressed. Still need long-term: instrumenter owners should stop emitting per-GPU unique ids in metric labels, add filtering in the exporter or use constant labels
len: filing task in infra: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4567 to add write_relabel for prod and follow-up with ML infra to change exporter
alex: for now, will backport relabel to prom-main during low-traffic window at 03:00 UTC. anyone object? :thumbsup:
jordan: +1
maria: +1
len: +1
alex: closing thread — will post after prod rollout
